run_led_test: run the test_led example to turn all LEDs off then set channels 1-3 to red, green, and blue
test_get_digit360_devices: test the get_digit360_devices function to discover connected DIGIT360 USB devices and return their descriptors
test_led_all_off: test the led_all_off function to reset all lighting channels on a DIGIT360 device
test_led_set_channel: test the led_set_channel function to set an RGB color on a specific lighting channel of a DIGIT360 device
test_Digit360_class: test the Digit360 class to connect to a serial port and send or receive Digit360Message frames
